seoTitle: GCPS Calendar 2025-2026: Gwinnett Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: GCPS 2025-2026 calendar with Aug 4 first day, May 20 last day, fall break, Thanksgiving, winter break, spring break, digital learning days and PDF.
calendarNotes: Gwinnett County Public Schools lists 180 student days for 2025-2026. The first day of school is August 4, 2025 and the last day is May 20, 2026. Fall Break is October 9-13, Thanksgiving Break is November 24-28, Winter Break is December 22, 2025 through January 1, 2026, and Spring Break is April 6-10, 2026. The calendar also lists digital learning days, early release days, teacher planning days, and staff development days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does GCPS start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Gwinnett County Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCPS Fall Break in 2025?
When is GCPS Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break school holidays run December 22, 2025 through January 1, 2026. January 2 is a teacher planning and staff development day, and students begin the second semester on January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCPS Spring Break in 2026?
When is the last day of school for GCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 20, 2026.
